Be in a relationship/have a partner and don’t have too many kids. I am a millennial and used to be a homeless junkie. Now I work in big tech and make $300,000 a year.

It has to be work all day, study the industry at night and learn everything you can. It is taking advantage of AI and understanding how to use it.

I am not saying it isn’t harder. I am not saying that wages haven’t stagnated for many different careers. I am saying that it is possible, you just have to shift your mindset, work ethic, and absorb everything you can.

Unpopular opinion, but I did it from homelessness with a criminal record in 4 states, with no degree, to now living the dream. I am not special. You can do it.
